[Story]
Zhang San is an engineer in the company, he works hard and diligently. In a work report, Zhang San proposes his new idea for software development, but Li Si, as his leader, thinks that this plan has technical and economic implementation difficulties.

[Question]
How does Zhang San persuade Li Si?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Zhang San can invite Li Si to participate in a key link of the plan, letting him experience and understand the implementation process of the plan.
B. Zhang San can present successful cases of similar plans in other companies.
C. Zhang San can emphasize how much effort he puts in, hoping that Li Si supports his plan based on trust in him.
D. Zhang San can persuade Li Si through other colleagues or channels.
